body.message:
Hello. I've been writing about the issue with the air conditioner multiple times now via email. On 31st March, 7th April and today. The air conditioner barely works and it's unbearable to sleep at night. 
A maintenance man came only once and never returned again. No works were done. He only came once to ask who's going to pay for the air conditioner check up and cleaning. 

I don't know what to do anymore and who to contact. I emailed Afifa and complaints multiple times.
